verdict.rationale: Lithic is not itself an agent but a payments API platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis; docs and a probe confirm an official MCP server exists that lets AI assistants search docs, inspect schemas, and execute live API calls, with a blog walkthrough of agentic use (creating cards, configuring rules, running test transactions). Missing for 10: independent/third-party hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs and blog.
